name: Huizhou CEE Technology Inc.
summary: Huizhou CEE Technology Inc. focuses on the research and development, production, sales and service of printed circuit boards in China and internationally. The company offers rigid printed circuit boards, flexible printed circuit boards, rigid-flex printed circuit boards, and flexible printed circuit assembly. It also provides multi-layer printed circuit boards, high-density interconnect boards, and rigid-flexible printed circuit boards. The company serves consumer electronics, automotive, advanced displays, security, industrial control, healthcare, artificial intelligence, big data, cloud computing, IoT, biometrics, wearables, smart homes, and drone sectors.
